question: The Arjuna Award is given for excellence in which field?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sports**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Arjuna Award**, officially known as the **Arjuna Awards for Outstanding Performance in Sports and Games**, is the second-highest sporting honour in **India**, after the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**.
 
• It was instituted in the year **1961** by the **Government of India** to recognize outstanding achievements in **National Sports**. The award is named after **Arjuna**, a primary protagonist from the ancient Indian epic, the **Mahabharata**, who was known for his mastery in archery and focus.
 
• As per the latest guidelines, to be eligible for the award, a sportsperson must have shown consistent outstanding performance at the **international level** for the preceding **four years**.
 
• In addition to performance, the sportsperson should have shown qualities of **leadership**, **sportsmanship**, and a sense of **discipline**.
 
• The award carries a **cash prize** of **₹15,00,000** (**15 Lakhs**), a **bronze statue** of **Arjuna** with his bow, and a **scroll of honour**. The cash prize was significantly increased from **₹5 lakh** to **₹15 lakh** in the year **2020**.
 
• The nominations for the award are received by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports**, and the selection is made by a committee headed by a retired **High Court** or **Supreme Court Judge** along with eminent sports personalities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award:**
 
 
• This is the **highest sporting honour** of **India**. It was formerly known as the **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award**.
 
• It was instituted in **1991–1992**. The first recipient was the Chess Grandmaster **Viswanathan Anand**.
 
• The award includes a **cash prize** of **₹25,00,000** (**25 Lakhs**).
 
 
 
• **Dronacharya Award:**
 
 
• Instituted in **1985**, this award is given to **coaches** for their excellence in sports coaching.
 
• It honors those who have enabled athletes to achieve outstanding results in **international events**.
 
• The **Regular Category** award carries a prize of **₹10 lakh**, while the **Lifetime Category** carries **₹15 lakh**.
 
 
 
• **Dhyan Chand Award for Lifetime Achievement:**
 
 
• Instituted in **2002**, it is awarded to individuals for their **lifetime contribution** to sports development.
 
• It is named after the legendary Indian hockey player **Major Dhyan Chand**.
 
• The award includes a **statue**, a **certificate**, and a cash prize of **₹10,00,000**.
 
 
 
• **National Sports Day:**
 
 
• The **National Sports Awards** are typically presented by the **President of India** at the **Rashtrapati Bhavan** on **29th August** every year.
 
• This date marks the **birth anniversary** of **Major Dhyan Chand**, known as the "**Wizard of Hockey**."
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The first recipients of the **Arjuna Award** in **1961** included **Salim Durani** for **Cricket**, **Sarbit Singh** for **Basketball**, and **Manuel Aaron** for **Chess**.
 
• The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** also awards the **Maulana Abul Kalam Azad (MAKA) Trophy** to the overall top-performing **University** in inter-university tournaments.
 
• The **Rashtriya Khel Protsahan Puruskar** is awarded to **corporate entities** (both private and public sector) and **NGOs** for their contribution to the promotion and development of sports.
 
• Recently, in **2023**, **26 athletes** were conferred with the **Arjuna Award**, including **Mohammed Shami** for his exceptional performance in **Cricket** during the **ODI World Cup**.
